answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. The defense holds because trust accrues slowly and is lost fast, so a farm that ever submits a copied answer destroys the value of that identity. Consider a vine as the anchor of the cost. A terrace stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a whisper holds the rep...
